name: Glauchau (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically red and white, charged at the top with the city arms of Glauchau (a tower with a crescent on blue beside a chequy field).
history: On 15 April 1897 Glauchau received the approval of the Royal Kreishauptmannschaft Zwickau to bear the arms established by the Hauptstaatsarchiv Dresden.

features.role: Glauchau arms — tower with crescent and chequy
